additions.group: 科学計測・蛍光顕微鏡焦点ぼけ逆問題・不連続Galerkin作用素
additions.reason_selected: Independent trained DGNO Cell/Face fluorescence defocus reconstruction, two channels/tasks (nuclei and actin), local volume integrals and interface flux; PULSE is 4x upscaling, TerraFM representation, MedGemma medical VLM; not substitutes. Retain w1 Cell and w2 Face as two distinct training outcomes under one repository identity; do not select other four checkpoints or training archive by default.
additions.quality_positive: ICML 2026 Table 1 BBBC006 w1 Cell PSNR 37.22 dB vs Restormer 35.35, MPT+EFCR 35.44; w2 Face 32.66 vs Restormer 31.70. w1 Cell SSIM 0.959 LPIPS 0.103; w2 Face 0.847/0.323.
additions.quality_negative: w2 Cell SSIM 0.848 and LPIPS 0.322 slightly better than Face despite PSNR 32.54. Paper reports 15 GB GPU memory at 512x512, hardware/clock/batch of that table unspecified; no owner benchmark. Single-plate fluorescence domain, no diagnostic validation. .pth deserialization and raw/EMA distinction require review; README Python3.9 vs requirements Python3.8.
additions.risk_and_alternative_assessment: Nonclinical lawful fluorescence-image research only; do not infer original structures or clinical findings from restored images without independent measurement. HF weights Apache-2.0 tag; pinned GitHub LICENSE is Restormer Academic Public License, noncommercial and same-license redistribution, so no commercial or owner act rights approval.
